name: Gilbreth Motion Economy
axiom: Each wasted motion costs time and fatigue; remove it rather than speed it up.
trigger: A control used every few seconds sits at the far edge of the screen.

checklist.text: Place controls used together, and most-used controls, inside one-handed reach.
Keep primary actions in the lower third of a phone screen, near the thumb.
Let a gesture finish where it started; avoid crossing the screen mid-task.

antiPattern.violation: Checkout puts Apply Promo bottom-left and Pay top-right, a reach across the whole screen.
antiPattern.remediation: Both actions sit in one bottom sheet within thumb reach.

parametricParams.caption: SUPERFLUOUS MOVEMENT COSTS TIME AND FATIGUE

academicOrigin.title: Motion Study: A Method for Increasing the Efficiency of the Workman
academicOrigin.publication: D. Van Nostrand Company, New York
